Albania is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a trip to Albania, the experience is nothing short of transformative.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore Albania depends on what you want to experience. Spring brings mild weather and blooming landscapes.

## Top Attractions

- Must-see sights that define Albania
- Hidden spots only locals know about
- Natural sites that tell the story of Albania
- Scenic lookouts for unforgettable photos

## Local Cuisine

No trip to Albania is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Walking is the best way to experience the true charm of Albania, with most major sights within easy reach.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts and budget hostels coexist in Albania, giving travelers plenty of options.
